issue.title: Add Tests for QNNRegressor and QNNClassifier
issue.body:
This PR
- adds tests for `QNNRegressor` and `QNNClassifier`
- fixes error handling of `solve_minibatch`
- changes the `UserWarning` to a `RuntimeError` when trying to predict with an unfitted `QNNClassifier`

partially solves #13

body: PR #74 will add tests for `QNNRegressor` and `QNNClassifier`. They can be used as templates on how to formulate your tests. Please try to Cover as much of the basic functionality of the modules without implementing a full unit-test setup. This is for other times.
